title: Test Mod
description: A Test mod I made to test my skills in mod making.
body:
# My First Mod!
# Features:

### Commands:

Utility commands: /fly Gamemode: /gmc /gma /gms /gmsp, (gm = gamemode) (/fly and /gmc need cheats enabled!)

Sound Effect commands: /pandemonium /getout (these work in servers! but no one will hear it)
### Other:

Advancement: A catalyst for dissapointment.

Iron Multitool: Does everything iron tools can, but can't till grass.

# Credits:

Made with MCreator!
